comment: Hand-scored transition fixtures for the practice board. Scoring counts MERGED TILE VALUES, not tile mass: [2,2,4,4] left merges 2+2->4 and 4+4->8 and earns 4+8=12. Spawning earns 0. No-op moves earn 0 and never spawn. Shared by the on-page control (playground/js/app.mjs) and the Node tests (playground/test/engine.test.mjs). Direction convention: 0=Up, 1=Right, 2=Down, 3=Left.

fixtures.name: [2,2,4,4] left earns 12 (merged tile values, not mass)
[2,4,2,0] left is a no-op (earns 0, never spawns, log untouched)

spawnEarnsZero.comment: After any legal move the recorded spawn contributes 0 to the score; only merged tile values accrue.
